pure-announcement.rationale: This is the vendor's own launch press release — news-summary bullets, adoption logos, a market forecast and a CEO quote; the underlying technique (learned decoders and calibration models for quantum error correction) exists independently in the literature, but this document is solely the announcement of a product family.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Performance claims are attributed, though vendor-benchmarked.

durability.rationale: Launch-day performance multipliers and adopter lists age immediately; rated for completeness though the disqualifier decides.

actionability.rationale: Points at model downloads; no transferable procedure.
